entities.name: Zedruu
entities.description: A legendary minotaur monk whose sacrifice broke a plague curse on her Erlundi people.

entities.name: Erlundi
entities.description: Zedruu's people, cursed by a plague.

events.summary: A plague cursed the Erlundi people; Zedruu offered her life for them and the curse was broken.
events.quote: Desperate, Zedruu offered her life in exchange for her people's, and thanks to her willing sacrifice, the curse was broken.
